summary: Megan Holdings Ltd. filed a 6-K disclosing an October 28, 2026 securities purchase agreement with several named investors for a reasonable best-efforts public offering of 15,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.50 per share, roughly $7.5 million gross; the offering closed October 29, 2026, under an effective Form F-1 (333-299548). Purchasers received six-month rights to 30% of certain subsequent financings. Prime Number Capital was exclusive placement agent at 6.0% cash fee plus 1.0% expense allowance and up to $100,000 reimbursements. This is a routine primary equity raise with lock-ups and a six-month standstill, not a special situation; watch dilution and follow-on participation overhang.
